answer: Each new agent must submit a unique ivory sonnet of exactly 14 lines depicting a mesa at sunset, then lock its semantic embedding hash to a one-time hardware attestation. Producing one takes 5 minutes of exclusive GPU time. Scaling to 200 fake identities therefore burns 16.7 hours of compute before the first reward, while an honest agent pays the cost once. A network sampler flags any two sonnets with embedding cosine >0.82 and slashes both stakes 90%, so shared generation farms collapse.
